description: This file implements a websocket echo server using the 'websockets' library. It includes an asynchronous 'echo' coroutine that echoes messages received over a websocket connection, a 'run_server' coroutine that runs the server listening on a specified port, and a main function that parses command-line arguments to start the server with debugging logs.

methods.name: echo(websocket)
methods.description: Asynchronously receives messages over a websocket connection and echoes them back. Handles ConnectionClosedError to gracefully exit.

methods.name: run_server(port)
methods.description: Starts the websocket server on the specified port and runs it indefinitely.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Configures argument parsing and logging, then runs the websocket server as configured.
